Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The class MyThread extends java.lang.Thread but does not override the run method or pass a Runnable target to the Thread constructor. As a result, when the thread is started, it will not perform any specific action.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test calls the showBug method and directly starts a MyThread instance. Since MyThread does not override the run method, starting the thread does not perform any specific action, causing the tests to fail and thereby demonstrating the bug.
